title: AGENTS.md
text: Crash wrong sign '' argument first sample < 1 s epoch boundary (padded seq(data_start, t1 - 1, ...)). 1-second gap: padding stopped t1 - 1 instead just t1. PR #51, counts identical without padding example GT3X (starts 0.5 s 37.5 s past minute checked).

what: What agcounts still gets wrong (as of PR #51)
title: AGENTS.md
text: Extra columns: padding rbind(data.frame(time, X, Y, Z), raw), errors (numbers columns arguments match) raw columns (e.g. GENEActiv light, temperature). reachable acti_calculate_counts(resample = FALSE): actibase::acti_resample() already drops non-XYZ columns. Spurious zero-count rows (agcounts issue #42): expected-timestamp grid built unaligned first time, appends zero rows duplicate epochs (39 real minutes -> 78 rows). acti_calculate_counts() fixes flooring time epoch summing. Version: Suggests requires agcounts (>= 0.6.7); CRAN release may contain PR #51.

what: Why we keep fix_first_second = TRUE as the default
title: AGENTS.md
text: Padding first avoids three: agcounts sees aligned data, neither padding (rbind) unaligned timestamp grid used, regardless installed agcounts version. padding keeps columns attributes, uses exact sample grid epoch start, keeps timezone. acti_calculate_counts() also runs acti_standardize_data(subset_xyz = TRUE) first, agcounts ever sees time/X/Y/Z (also maps names like TIME/HEADER_TIME_STAMP lower-case x). fixes (1) even fix_first_second = FALSE, keeps sample_rate transformations attributes. fix (2) (3), padding stays. remove floor--sum step agcounts::calculate_counts() padding without re-checking cases.

title: actimetrics 0.10.0
text: New sleep-period-time guiders following GGIR sleep definitions (implemented without calling GGIR): acti_sleep_hdcza(), acti_sleep_hlrb(), acti_sleep_horangle(), acti_sleep_l5(), acti_sleep_notworn(), acti_sleep_setwindow(), acti_sleep_diary(), dispatched acti_sleep_guider() (see acti_sleep_guider_requirements()). acti_sleep_sib() detects sustained inactivity bouts, acti_sleep_label() acti_sleep_labels() turn guiders epoch-level sleep/wake labels, acti_sleep_fuse_labels() combines labels STAPLE, acti_sleep_ensemble() runs whole pipeline raw epoch data. New activity-intensity classifiers: acti_threshold_counts() acti_threshold_enmo() user-supplied cut-points, published cut-points acti_threshold_montoye(), acti_threshold_sasaki(), acti_threshold_romanzini(), acti_threshold_hildebrand() (acti_threshold_hildebrand_wrist() acti_threshold_hildebrand_hip()). acti_calculate_wear_raw_ggir() (method = "ggir", default): GGIR non-wear clipping algorithm (van Hees et al. 2011, 2013), exposing GGIR’s settings: medium/long window sizes, "2023" "2013" approaches, standard-deviation range thresholds, clipping threshold dynamic range, edge correction, night-time short non-wear filter. acti_calculate_wear_raw_actipy() (method = "actipy"): stationary episodes Doherty et al. (2017), actipy’s detect_nonwear(), window, patience, standard-deviation threshold exposed.

title: actimetrics 0.10.0
text: acti_process() frees raw data counts calculated, non-wear detection day inclusion. acti_calculate_stepcount() (py_acti_calculate_stepcount()) now return times input’s time zone. stepcount reports local clock times without time zone, previously labelled UTC, shifting steps input’s UTC offset (e.g. one hour British Summer Time). new tz argument sets time zone, needed file input (default "UTC"). epoch/unit arguments standardized actibase::acti_standardize_epoch(), acti_calculate_counts() accepts epoch = "1 min" measure functions accept numeric seconds strings "30s". ensure_all_time = TRUE longer errors units "5 seconds" "1 minute", acti_calculate_mims() longer errors units without space "1min". acti_calculate_ai() acti_calculate_mad() now default verbose = TRUE. acti_apply_cole_kripke(), acti_apply_sadeh(), acti_apply_tudor_locke() longer add superfluous vector.magnitude column (copy counts) output. acti_apply_cole_kripke() acti_apply_sadeh() longer return count column actigraph.sleepr uses internally scoring (axis1 truncated , Cole-Kripke, divided 100). overwrote count column input, now kept.
